DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

This diagnosis is confirmed by the characteristic multifocal demyelinating lesions seen on your MRI without contrast enhancement, which is highly specific for JC virus infection. Given your significant medical history, are you currently undergoing treatment for HIV, lymphoma, or any other immunosuppressive therapy?
